author: Stahly
description:
I've tested the complete Kaleido Colorworks range from Gaahleri: Primary Colors, Automotive, Mecha Colors, and more. These pre-thinned acrylic paints are supposed to match the atomisation and durability of a lacquer paint, but without the solvents or the smell. A lot of YouTubers are raving about Gaahleri products, but I do wonder how much of it actually holds up, and what's just hidden advertising. Here comes my honest and 100% spoon-free review.

The post Are Kaleido Colorworks paints really a game changer for airbrushing? Full range review appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Are Kaleido Colorworks paints really a game changer for airbrushing? Full range review
